response.rationale: R3 matches the classic nasal NK/T-cell lymphoma immunophenotype (CD56+, EBV+, CD20-, PAX5-) and the nasal location; R1 is contradicted by CD56 positivity and the HIV-negative status, which are atypical for plasmablastic lymphoma.

rejected.why: Redundant completion of R3; adds no new evidence beyond the already included EBV-positive span.
